main_text.l: Item ἤδην Atticé pro εἰδὴν noram, ab
Aliquando etiam in medio fit au-
ἑόρτα, ἐώρτην, feci, eram: pro ἠόλπην,
ἔοικα, ἐώκην, similis sum, similis eram:

page.notes: Greek transcribed from a small, faded scan; several accents and breathings are uncertain and may be misread. The heading "Augmentum temporale" is italic in the original. "Horisticum" may read "Historicum" or "Horisticum"; treat with caution.
